summary: Recent headlines highlight challenges facing D.C. residents across multiple policy areas, from workplace protections to voting access and security concerns, while also documenting continued advocacy efforts for statehood. Senator Slotkin has pledged to prioritize D.C. statehood, and DC Vote is expanding its organizing capacity. Without statehood, D.C. residents have no voting representation in Congress, and Congress can override any law the District passes.
